name: 45309 · Brookville, OH
findings: ZIP 45309 (Brookville) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45309 (Brookville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
